[9:57PM] #Apongbon #TrafficUpdate 

Good vehicular movement from CMS Bridge inward Offin Canal Market stretch, extending to Ijora Olopa by NEPA Intersection.
Efficient traffic flow on Broad Street stretch to Apongbon underneath the bridge, connecting Offin Canal Market, Olowogbowo, and Offin Canal Market.
Smooth movement on Eko Bridge by NEPA Intersection inward Apongbon, and descending Eko Bridge inward CMS, Elegbeta Mini Stadium, Ebute-Ero Market.
Good traffic conditions from Ebute-Ero Market inward Leventist, through UBA Roundabout, connecting Inner and Outer Marina.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 3 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat) and Low Pressure Area (LPA)
Issued at: 5:00 AM, 08 June 2025(Sunday)

ORANGE WARNING LEVEL: Metro Manila, Rizal, Cavite, Laguna, Batangas, Bulacan and Quezon(General Nakar, Infanta, Real, Mauban, Sampaloc, Lucban, Tayabas, Candelaria, Dolores, Sariaya, Tiaong, San Antonio, Lucena, Pagbilao, Panukulan, Burdeos, Polillo, Jomalig, Patnanungan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING is still THREATENING.

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Nueva Ecija, Tarlac, Pampanga, Zambales, Bataan and Quezon(Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Buenavista, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Gumaca, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Padre Burgos, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan, Unisan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
